evals.name: apply-fix-recommendation
evals.prompt: Run improve. The last retro recommended: Add 'Validation uses zod schemas in src/lib/validators.ts' to AGENTS.md (P1, fix).
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md is edited with the new line, structural validation passes, change is accepted with diff stats.
assertions: AGENTS.md was modified
Structural validation (lint-definition.py) was run on the modified file
Report table shows the recommendation as 'accepted'
Report table includes a Diff column with lines added/removed
Improve outcome JSON was saved to ~/agent-retros/ with 'type': 'improve'
Outcome JSON includes 'changes' array with per-file lines_added/lines_removed

evals.name: revert-on-structural-failure
evals.prompt: Run improve. The last retro recommended: Remove the description field from agents/planner/AGENT.md frontmatter (P0, fix).
evals.expected_output: The edit is attempted, structural validation fails (missing required field), the change is reverted, and the file is restored.
assertions: agents/planner/AGENT.md was initially edited
Structural validation was run and returned an S-code error
The change was reverted — agents/planner/AGENT.md is back to its original content
Report table shows the recommendation as 'reverted' with reason 'structural: fail'

evals.name: short-circuit-patterns-only
evals.prompt: Run improve. The last retro had only pattern recommendations (no fixes): 'When building new pages, search for existing similar pages first' (P2, pattern).
evals.expected_output: Apply-verify loop is skipped entirely. Pattern is saved to memory. No file edits.
assertions: No source files were modified
A memory file was created or updated
MEMORY.md index was updated
Report shows 0 accepted, 0 reverted, 1 saved

evals.name: rewrite-threshold
evals.prompt: Run improve. The last retro produced 6 fix recommendations all targeting agents/staff-engineer/AGENT.md.
evals.expected_output: Improve detects the rewrite threshold (5+ findings on same file) and recommends review-skill instead of patching.
assertions: agents/staff-engineer/AGENT.md was NOT modified
Output recommends running review-skill on the file
No individual patches were attempted

evals.name: p0-carve-out
evals.prompt: Run improve. The last retro produced 6 fix recommendations all targeting agents/staff-engineer/AGENT.md. One of them is P0: 'Remove the broken model field that causes crashes on startup.'
evals.expected_output: Improve detects the rewrite threshold but applies the single P0 finding, then stops and recommends review-skill for the remaining 5 findings.
assertions: agents/staff-engineer/AGENT.md was modified exactly once (the P0 finding only)
Report table shows exactly 1 accepted change
Output recommends running review-skill for the remaining findings
The 5 non-P0 findings were not applied

evals.name: validate-converges
evals.prompt: Run improve --validate. The last retro recommended: Add a gotchas section to agents/planner/AGENT.md (P1, fix). When asked for max iterations, use the default (3).
evals.expected_output: Improve applies the fix, then runs review-skill on agents/planner/AGENT.md. If review-skill returns PASS, validation converges in 1 iteration. Report shows both improve results and validation loop table.
assertions: User was prompted for max validation iterations before the loop started
Inline review checks (linter + semantic review) were run on agents/planner/AGENT.md without invoking the Skill tool
Validation loop report table is present with iteration count, reviewed, passed columns
Outcome JSON contains a 'validation' field with 'converged' and 'per_iteration' data
Only ONE outcome JSON file was created (not one per iteration)
Version was bumped exactly once (in the initial pass, not again in validation iterations)

evals.name: validate-stops-on-rewrite
evals.prompt: Run improve --validate. The last retro recommended 2 fixes targeting a poorly-written skill. After improve applies them, review-skill returns REWRITE. Max iterations: 3.
evals.expected_output: Validation loop exits immediately on REWRITE verdict without attempting further iterations. Reports the REWRITE verdict and recommends review-skill for a full rewrite.
assertions: Validation loop ran exactly 1 iteration (reviewed, got REWRITE, stopped)
Report shows stopped_reason as 'rewrite_verdict'
No second iteration was attempted
Output recommends running review-skill for a full rewrite

evals.name: validate-no-double-version-bump
evals.prompt: Run improve --validate. The last retro recommended: Add error handling guidance to agents/quality-engineer/AGENT.md (P1, fix). After improve applies it (bumping 1.0.0 → 1.0.1), review-skill returns NEEDS WORK with 1 additional finding. The second iteration fixes it and review-skill returns PASS. Max iterations: 3.
evals.expected_output: Version is bumped once to 1.0.1 in the initial pass. The validation iteration applies the review-skill finding but does NOT bump the version again. Changelog has one entry, not two.
assertions: agents/quality-engineer/AGENT.md version is 1.0.1 (not 1.0.2)
agents/quality-engineer/CHANGELOG.md has exactly one new entry for this improve run
Validation iteration did not call version bump step
Outcome JSON validation.per_iteration shows 2 iterations

evals.name: validate-all-patterns-short-circuit
evals.prompt: Run improve --validate. The last retro had only pattern recommendations (no fixes): 'When building new pages, search for existing similar pages first' (P2, pattern).
evals.expected_output: Apply-verify loop is skipped entirely. Pattern is saved to memory. --validate has no effect message is shown. Validation loop is not started. No file edits.
assertions: No source files were modified
A memory file was created or updated
MEMORY.md index was updated
Report shows 0 accepted, 0 reverted, 1 saved
Output informs user that '--validate has no effect — all recommendations are patterns'
Validation loop was not started

evals.name: validate-skip-heuristic
evals.prompt: Run improve --validate. The last retro recommended: Add a gotcha about path resolution to skills/retro/SKILL.md (P2, fix). The edit adds 1 line to the Gotchas section and removes 0 lines.
evals.expected_output: Improve applies the additive-only gotcha edit. The --validate loop checks the skip heuristic: lines_removed==0 AND edit targets Gotchas section AND no workflow steps modified → loop is skipped with explanation. No validation iterations run.
assertions: skills/retro/SKILL.md was modified (gotcha added)
Structural validation passed
Output includes skip message: 'Skipping --validate loop: all changes are additive-only edits to Gotchas/references sections'
Validation loop iteration table is NOT present in the report
Outcome JSON does not contain a 'validation' field (or contains validation.skipped: true)
